summary: Phase 18 review — 1-click public 'Pay this invoice' email-to-PayPal flow + BreezeDocs proposals & contracts (Round 4). Backend: 15/15 new Phase-18 pytests PASS (test_breezedocs.py 10/10 + test_pay_invoice_link.py 5/5). Full pytest suite: 246/249 (1 pre-existing skip, 2 pre-existing PayPal-webhook intermittent timeouts unrelated to Phase 18 — webhook endpoints reachable, just slow under load). Integrations health endpoint now includes `breezedocs` (status=green, configured=true). POST /api/admin/integrations/breezedocs/test returns {ok:true, mode:'live', status:200, email:'founder@thesalvador.group'} — LIVE auth verified against the real BreezeDoc account. APScheduler cron `breezedocs_sync_cron_wrapper` registered with CronTrigger(minute='*/10') in server.py:242. Frontend verified live on https://seo-dashboard-test.preview.emergentagent.com: (1) /admin/proposals renders header 'Proposals & contracts' + 'LIVE — connected to BreezeDoc' subheader + 3 stat tiles + search + status filter + New Proposal button + sidebar 'Proposals' link active under Sales. (2) New Proposal dialog opens with 5 live BreezeDoc templates loaded (CrossCurrent Traders' LDART.pdf, General Business Contract, Business Coaching Agreement, NDA, Marketing Project Agreement). (3) Public /pay/invoice/{id} renders standalone (no auth) with INV number, balance $50.00, large 'Pay with PayPal' button, line items, and 'Sign in to your portal' link. (4) Once invoice marked paid, same URL renders green 'Paid' badge + 'This invoice has been paid in full' banner + Pay button correctly removed. (5) Client portal (demo@bybloomlabs.com) shows Invoices tab with 2 ISSUED invoices each with prominent 'Pay now' button + PDF download; Proposals tab renders 'No proposals waiting' empty state (correct — no live proposals scoped to demo email). Regression: existing invoice CRUD, subscriptions, and AgencyHandy-free payment-capture flows untouched (test_invoices.py, test_subscriptions.py, test_phase16.py all green).

issues: 'Send to client now' toggle defaults to TRUE in live mode — risky for accidental real-email firing. Consider defaulting to FALSE (draft) when integration mode is 'live', or adding a confirmation step before submit. Low priority because checkbox is visible and admin must explicitly fill client_email.

'Pay now' button has no data-testid attribute — works functionally (2 buttons rendered, link to /pay/invoice/{id}) but harder to target in future Playwright tests. Add data-testid='client-portal-invoice-pay-now-{id}' for symmetry with PDF download.

action_items: Optional: add data-testid attributes to client-portal 'Pay now' buttons in ClientPortal.jsx for testability.
Optional UX: default 'Send to client now' to false in /admin/proposals create dialog when breezedocs.mode==='live' to prevent accidental real-email sends.

Pay endpoint 409 on paid + 404 on unknown ids verified live with real PATCH→GET flow against the deployed backend.

breezedocs_routes.py admin endpoints + client endpoint all gated by JWT — confirmed by test_admin_breezedocs_routes_require_auth (4 routes return 401/403) and test_client_breezedocs_endpoint_requires_auth.

/api/admin/breezedocs/proposals POST validates required fields (template_id+client_email+client_name) returning 400/422 — covered by test_create_proposal_validates_required_fields.
APScheduler breezedocs_sync_cron registered cleanly at server.py:242 with 10-min cron — confirmed via grep + the test_breezedocs_test_endpoint live LIVE response (`mode:'live', status:200`).
Integration health endpoint now lists breezedocs as 10th provider with green status (configured + live ping ok).
